selector.rationale: Biopsy demonstrated acute inflammation and foci of endometriosis, supporting the diagnosis of endometriosis, which best explains the patient's symptoms and findings without contradiction.

rejected.label: Acute Appendicitis
rejected.why: Appendix was not identified during diagnostic laparoscopy and biopsy did not support appendicitis

rejected.label: Inverted Appendix
rejected.why: No direct evidence of an inverted appendix was found during diagnostic laparoscopy

rejected.label: Neoplasm
rejected.why: No conclusive evidence of a neoplasm was found, and the patient's symptoms and findings are better explained by endometriosis
